input.resize: PIL RGB bilinear stretch, not LetterBox
input.CPP_input: uint8 RGB NHWC0..255, RKNN config /255 once; no second division
input.decode_resize: OpenCV/RGA resize equivalence is NOT assumed; fixtures contain exact RGB bytes

detection.boxes: continuous xyxy, no inclusive +1 in IoU
detection.expected_asset: provided category in original C protocol
detection.selection: highest confidence expected class, ties lexicographic xyxy
detection.fallback: full320 ROI when expected class absent, mark fallback; never claim normally detected

ROI.boundary: outside feature coordinates[-1,W]/[-1,H] =>zero; otherwise clamp edge then bilinear
ROI.sequence: raw P3 -> ROI -> patch channelL2 eps1e-12

score.bank: per-asset matching normal support path; not contained in RKNN model

normal_banks: NOT rebuilt/exported by this conversion task; export target-precision matching banks before full anomaly deployment
evaluation: No test query inference/AUROC, no test-derived alarm threshold in this conversion task
